criteria.name: Action honored
criteria.fiveMeans: The rewrite does what was asked: expanded (more detail), clearer (re-explained), an analogy added, deeper (more technical depth), or a focused ELI5 of just this section.

anchors.excerpt: Action: analogy. Before: 'Safety stock covers demand above forecast.' After: 'Safety stock is extra inventory that covers demand above forecast.'
anchors.why: Reworded, but no analogy was added.

anchors.excerpt: Action: analogy. After adds: 'Think of it like packing one more snack than you expect to need for a long drive: you pay a little to avoid running out.'
anchors.why: A fitting analogy for exactly this section's idea.

criteria.name: Consistent with surrounding sections
criteria.fiveMeans: Fits the neighbouring sections: no contradictions, no repetition of what they already say, same terms and tone.

anchors.excerpt: Rewritten section says lead time is four weeks; the next section still says six weeks and repeats the whole forecasting explanation.
anchors.why: Contradicts a neighbour and duplicates its content.

anchors.excerpt: Rewritten section uses the same six-week lead time and hands off to the next section: 'The next section shows how that buffer is sized.'
anchors.why: Consistent facts and a smooth hand-off.

anchors.excerpt: Note: 'use a cooking analogy'. After: an analogy about traffic lights.
Note: 'use a cooking analogy'. After: 'It is like prepping ingredients before dinner service so orders can go out fast.'
